findings.title: The BAA is a draft, must be signed with the MSA, and nothing covers patient data until it is
findings.quote: This BAA may be executed in counterparts and by electronic signature, and shall be executed concurrently with the Master Services Agreement.
findings.explanation: The BAA is Exhibit D to the MSA, effective on the MSA's Effective Date, and must be executed at the same time as the MSA. It reached AtliQ on 16 Sep and is unsigned; Harrington wants both signed by 1 Oct (tracker C-046; 27 Sep huddle). findings.title: No PHI offshore, and every subcontractor must be a US entity with US staff; AtliQ's delivery team is in Pune
findings.quote: Business Associate shall not engage any Subcontractor in connection with the Services without Covered Entity's prior written approval of such Subcontractor. Each approved Subcontractor shall be organized under the laws of a State of the United States, and all of its personnel performing Services shall be located in the United States.
findings.explanation: BAA §1.5 counts 'any Affiliate of Business Associate' as a Subcontractor, so AtliQ Technologies Pvt Ltd (India) is one. Under §4.2 it could not be an approved subcontractor at all: it is not a US entity and its people are not in the US. §4.1 separately bans PHI from or at any location outside the US 'whether directly or by remote access'. AtliQ's entity sheet says delivery teams for both entities sit in Pune. MSA §12.4 would allow offshore staff on de-identified data, but §4.2 is not limited to PHI. The CareBridge BAA did allow offshore access to de-identified data (§3.2); this one does not say so.

register_refs.quote: 3.2 Personnel of Business Associate or of any Subcontractor located outside the United States may access De-identified Data only, and only within the Covered Entity Environment or a secure environment approved in writing by Covered Entity. No PHI shall be accessed, stored or processed outside the United States.

6.1 Business Associate shall ensure, in accordance with 45 C.F.R. §§ 164.502(e)(1)(ii) and 164.308(b)(2), that any Subcontractor that creates, receives, maintains or transmits PHI on behalf of Business Associate agrees in a written business associate agreement to the same restrictions, conditions and requirements that apply to Business Associate under this BAA, including Section 3.

findings.title: Indemnity and liability for privacy events are one-way and expressly unlimited
findings.quote: The obligations of Business Associate under this Article 8 are not subject to any limitation or exclusion of liability, and shall apply notwithstanding any limitation of liability in the Master Services Agreement.
findings.explanation: AtliQ must cover all Losses from any Privacy Event (which includes suspected events, and events involving any Subcontractor or Affiliate), BAA breach or HIPAA/Texas-law violation, including regulatory fines, notification, call-centre, credit monitoring and forensics. There is no cap and it overrides any cap negotiated in the MSA, so even a successful change to MSA §10.3 would not limit this. Harrington gives no indemnity in the BAA, and nothing carves out Harrington's own part in an event. The CareBridge BAA, by contrast, capped BAA liability at 2x fees (§9.1); the checklist is 1x fees.

register_refs.quote: 9.1 Each Party's liability arising out of or relating to this BAA, including any Breach, is subject to the limitations and exclusions of liability in the Master Services Agreement, under which aggregate liability for claims relating to a Breach or a violation of this BAA shall not exceed two (2) times the Fees paid or payable under the Master Services Agreement in the twelve (12) months preceding the event giving rise to the claim.

findings.title: Harrington sets the cure period and can end the BAA and the whole MSA at once
findings.quote: If Covered Entity determines that Business Associate has violated a material term of this BAA, Covered Entity may, at its option, (a) provide Business Associate an opportunity to cure within a period specified by Covered Entity, and terminate this BAA and the Master Services Agreement if Business Associate does not cure; or (b) immediately terminate this BAA and the Master Services Agreement if cure is not possible.
findings.explanation: Only Harrington can terminate, Harrington decides what counts as a violation and how long the cure period is, and a BAA breach ends the MSA too. On MSA termination AtliQ is paid only for accepted Deliverables (MSA §5.3). The CareBridge BAA gave each side written notice and 30 days to cure (§10.2).
